method: Static first: all behaviour is native block JS on authored documents (header/footer/accordion/carousel/product-table/embed); host-bound data (eKomi quotes, article data) and client-rendered promo/ccw slots are settled snapshots authored in the documents; no query index (no delivered page lists or searches the corpus); martech scaffolded with every contract part disabled. dom-count checks assert the decorated interactive state (controls wired with aria-expanded / aria-controls); the interaction itself was replayed at 1440/360 by a probe on 2026-10-28 and its numbers are in verifiedBy.
